# socxen

> An open-source agentic SOC skill suite for Exabeam New-Scale — a plugin for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Three skills (soc-investigate, triage-cases, rule-tuning) over one guarded Exabeam MCP bridge, with a human-in-the-loop gate on dismiss/close, containment recommended but never executed, deterministic guardrails against hostile telemetry, and a red-team program that gates every release. Apache-2.0, sponsored by Exabeam, part of the Open Agent and AI Security Community.
